subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Gadgets In My Bag, Brilliant Response to Media Attacks, and Quotes on Genius

bullets.title: Inevitable Ending
bullets.creator: Armen Miran and Hraach (Viken Arman and Goldcap remix)
bullets.note: Great music for a million things. I’m currently using it for writing sessions, but it’s versatile.

bullets.title: An open letter from the French businessman who runs LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury goods company
bullets.creator: Bernard Arnault
bullets.note:
“Bernard Arnault rarely responds to criticism in public, but this time he published a detailed open letter after Le Monde spent 6 months investigating him and LVMH.”

The above is a case study in clever media-crisis management.

bullets.title: ProBody Pilates Ball
bullets.creator: ProBody Pilates
bullets.note: Yep, it’s a Pilates ball, but I don’t use it for Pilates. I keep it deflated in my backpack, and if I need lumbar support or butt padding anywhere on the road (in hotels, restaurants, airplanes, etc.), I give it literally 2–3 puffs of partial inflation and voilà! Deflated, this is small enough to fold up and stick in a jacket or jeans pocket.

bullets.section: Another tiny gadget in my backpack
bullets.title: Sennheiser Pro Audio Condenser Microphone
bullets.creator: Sennheiser
bullets.note: This lav mic plugs straight into an iPhone and makes on-the-go recordings sound much better than any built-in laptop or phone mic. It’s remarkable what quality you can get, especially if paired with [the Ferrite app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ferrite-recording-studio/id1018780185) that allows you to record high-fidelity audio straight on your iPhone.

bullets.title: Most geniuses—especially those who lead others—prosper not by deconstructing intricate complexities but by exploiting unrecognized simplicities.
bullets.creator: Andy Benoit
